job_post_detail.title: Retail Specialist-local
job_post_detail.description: Responsibilities Overview: We welcome fresh graduates who are interested in the retail industry to join us and create a better future together! Multi-channel retail management: Learn and master the company's retail channel operation model, participate in channel analysis and strategy adjustment. New retail model exploration: In-depth understanding of online and offline integration and new retail trends, participate in new retail project practice. Strategic operation analysis: Use data analytics to mine market opportunities and risks, and provide data support and strategy suggestions for retail business. Future opportunities: 1. Deeply participate in the formulation and execution of multi-channel retail strategies. 2. Participate in the innovative practice of international new retail and the development of the company's retail business. 3. Fully participate in all aspects of retail management to ensure the stable development of the business。
job_post_detail.requirement: 1. Have a certain knowledge and understanding of Xiaomi 2. Strong communication skills, outgoing personality, strong ability to coordinate resources, and strong willingness to grow 3. Have an active sense, be good at discovering and solving problems, and be able to propose reasonable improvement plans 4. Preference for operators who understand or are interested 5. Xiaomi agrees with its values "6. Fluent in English, which can be used as a working language 7. Bonus points: Microsoft Excel ability, data analytics ability, love hardware products, Xiaomi fans
